description: For an actual native arithmetic body \(A(x)\), an older-name bound term \(t\), and supplied context-uniform HA conversions of \(A\) to and from \(A^{\mathsf N}\), there are actual conversions between \(\forall x(x<t\to A(x))\) and its fixed negative translation, in every original finite additional context. The strict order guard has its actual additive expansion.
